# Nightly update recovery

These Chromium captures show Station’s update dialog with an injected installer failure at 390px and 1440px in both themes. They cover diagnostic wrapping, copy feedback and the retry controls.

The before captures use base `9e6cb0bdcb38e160c9eb01bdce7ae8b498497a7e`. The after captures use the UI source in this change. The fixture supplied the update state and server ownership. Native installer behavior is outside this capture.
